# NEW 2026-11-21 v8.5 Part A Module 3, Maghreb, Barbary Corsairs & Africa Exarchate (1337-1680, oe_mag_, slot 63). Generated by gen_maghreb_africa.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Country scope. Safely relieve oe_ar_strain when After Restoration burden is active.
oe_mag_relieve_ar_strain = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_ar_strain }
        oe_ar_add_strain = { amount = $amount$ }
    }
}

# Country scope. Apply bilateral bias among Maghreb tripartite rivals (MOR / TUN / TLE).
oe_mag_apply_tripartite_bias = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:MOR c:MOR = { is_rebel_country = no } NOT = { tag = MOR } }
        add_opinion = { modifier = $bias$ target = c:MOR }
        c:MOR = { add_opinion = { modifier = $bias$ target = root } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:TUN c:TUN = { is_rebel_country = no } NOT = { tag = TUN } }
        add_opinion = { modifier = $bias$ target = c:TUN }
        c:TUN = { add_opinion = { modifier = $bias$ target = root } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:TLE c:TLE = { is_rebel_country = no } NOT = { tag = TLE } }
        add_opinion = { modifier = $bias$ target = c:TLE }
        c:TLE = { add_opinion = { modifier = $bias$ target = root } }
    }
}

# Country scope. Ottoman-Barbary bilateral protection pact (c:TUR).
oe_mag_apply_ottoman_pact = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_mag_ottoman_patron_alive = yes }
        add_opinion = { modifier = oe_mag_b_ottoman_corsair_bond target = c:TUR }
        c:TUR = {
            add_opinion = { modifier = oe_mag_b_ottoman_corsair_bond target = root }
            add_navy_tradition = 5
        }
    }
}

# Country scope. Upgrade Strait of Gibraltar bastion (ceuta > tangier > capital).
oe_mag_upgrade_strait_port = {
    if = { limit = { owns = location:ceuta } location:ceuta = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_mag_strait_bastion_loc years = 35 mode = replace } } }
    if = { limit = { owns = location:tangier } location:tangier = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_mag_strait_bastion_loc years = 35 mode = replace } } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { owns = location:ceuta } NOT = { owns = location:tangier } exists = capital } capital = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_mag_strait_bastion_loc years = 35 mode = replace } } }
}

# Country scope. Upgrade Barbary corsair port (algiers > tunis > tripoli > oran > bejaia > capital).

    if = { limit = { owns = location:algiers } location:algiers = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_mag_corsair_haven_loc years = 30 mode = replace } } }
    else_if = { limit = { owns = location:tunis } location:tunis = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_mag_corsair_haven_loc years = 30 mode = replace } } }
    else_if = { limit = { owns = location:tripoli } location:tripoli = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_mag_corsair_haven_loc years = 30 mode = replace } } }
    else_if = { limit = { owns = location:oran } location:oran = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_mag_corsair_haven_loc years = 30 mode = replace } } }
    else_if = { limit = { owns = location:bejaia } location:bejaia = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_mag_corsair_haven_loc years = 30 mode = replace } } }
    else_if = { limit = { exists = capital } capital = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_mag_corsair_haven_loc years = 30 mode = replace } } }
}

            remove_location_modifier = oe_mag_corsair_haven_loc

# Any scope. Resolve Maghreb theater host (human priority, every location access has_owner guarded).
oe_mag_resolve_maghreb_host = {
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:MOR c:MOR = { is_rebel_country = no is_ai = no } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_host_maghreb value = c:MOR } }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:TUN c:TUN = { is_rebel_country = no is_ai = no } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_host_maghreb value = c:TUN } }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:TLE c:TLE = { is_rebel_country = no is_ai = no } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_host_maghreb value = c:TLE } }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:ALG c:ALG = { is_rebel_country = no is_ai = no } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_host_maghreb value = c:ALG } }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:MOR c:MOR = { is_rebel_country = no } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_host_maghreb value = c:MOR } }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:TUN c:TUN = { is_rebel_country = no } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_host_maghreb value = c:TUN } }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:TLE c:TLE = { is_rebel_country = no } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_host_maghreb value = c:TLE } }
    else_if = {
        limit = { location:fez = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_rebel_country = no } } }
        location:fez = { if = { limit = { has_owner = yes } owner = { save_scope_as = oe_mag_tmp_h set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_host_maghreb value = scope:oe_mag_tmp_h } } } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { location:tunis = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_rebel_country = no } } }
        location:tunis = { if = { limit = { has_owner = yes } owner = { save_scope_as = oe_mag_tmp_h set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_host_maghreb value = scope:oe_mag_tmp_h } } } }
    }
}

# Any scope. Resolve West Africa gold host (MAL / SON / owner of timbuktu / gao / niani; has_owner guarded).
oe_mag_resolve_wa_host = {
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:MAL c:MAL = { is_rebel_country = no is_ai = no } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_host_wa value = c:MAL } }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:SON c:SON = { is_rebel_country = no is_ai = no } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_host_wa value = c:SON } }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:MAL c:MAL = { is_rebel_country = no } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_host_wa value = c:MAL } }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:SON c:SON = { is_rebel_country = no } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_host_wa value = c:SON } }
    else_if = {
        limit = { location:timbuktu = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_rebel_country = no } } }
        location:timbuktu = { if = { limit = { has_owner = yes } owner = { save_scope_as = oe_mag_tmp_wa set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_host_wa value = scope:oe_mag_tmp_wa } } } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { location:gao = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_rebel_country = no } } }
        location:gao = { if = { limit = { has_owner = yes } owner = { save_scope_as = oe_mag_tmp_wa set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_host_wa value = scope:oe_mag_tmp_wa } } } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { location:niani = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_rebel_country = no } } }
        location:niani = { if = { limit = { has_owner = yes } owner = { save_scope_as = oe_mag_tmp_wa set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_host_wa value = scope:oe_mag_tmp_wa } } } }
    }
}

# Any scope. Resolve Barbary Corsair host (Muslim owner of algiers / tunis / tripoli, human priority; has_owner guarded).
oe_mag_resolve_corsair_host = {
    if = {
        limit = { location:algiers = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_rebel_country = no is_ai = no religion.group = religion_group:muslim } } }
        location:algiers = { if = { limit = { has_owner = yes } owner = { save_scope_as = oe_mag_tmp_c set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_host_corsair value = scope:oe_mag_tmp_c } } } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { location:tunis = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_rebel_country = no is_ai = no religion.group = religion_group:muslim } } }
        location:tunis = { if = { limit = { has_owner = yes } owner = { save_scope_as = oe_mag_tmp_c set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_host_corsair value = scope:oe_mag_tmp_c } } } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { location:tripoli = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_rebel_country = no is_ai = no religion.group = religion_group:muslim } } }
        location:tripoli = { if = { limit = { has_owner = yes } owner = { save_scope_as = oe_mag_tmp_c set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_host_corsair value = scope:oe_mag_tmp_c } } } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { location:algiers = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_rebel_country = no religion.group = religion_group:muslim } } }
        location:algiers = { if = { limit = { has_owner = yes } owner = { save_scope_as = oe_mag_tmp_c set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_host_corsair value = scope:oe_mag_tmp_c } } } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { location:tunis = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_rebel_country = no religion.group = religion_group:muslim } } }
        location:tunis = { if = { limit = { has_owner = yes } owner = { save_scope_as = oe_mag_tmp_c set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_host_corsair value = scope:oe_mag_tmp_c } } } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { location:tripoli = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_rebel_country = no religion.group = religion_group:muslim } } }
        location:tripoli = { if = { limit = { has_owner = yes } owner = { save_scope_as = oe_mag_tmp_c set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_host_corsair value = scope:oe_mag_tmp_c } } } }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:ALG c:ALG = { is_rebel_country = no } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_host_corsair value = c:ALG } }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:TUN c:TUN = { is_rebel_country = no } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_host_corsair value = c:TUN } }
}

# Any scope. Resolve Roman Empire host for Africa Exarchate & Rome-Sahara (ROM > BYZ).
oe_mag_resolve_roman_host = {
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:ROM c:ROM = { is_rebel_country = no } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_host_roman value = c:ROM } }
    else_if = { limit = { country_exists = c:BYZ c:BYZ = { is_rebel_country = no } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_host_roman value = c:BYZ } }
}

# Any scope. One-time initialization (1337+).
oe_mag_init_line = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_init value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_on value = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_end value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_sent_cnt value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_gold_surge value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_corsair_heat value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_exarch_step value = 0 }
    oe_mag_resolve_maghreb_host = yes
    oe_mag_resolve_wa_host = yes
    oe_mag_resolve_corsair_host = yes
    oe_mag_resolve_roman_host = yes
}

# Theater dispatchers (at most one oe_mag event per calendar month globally via oe_mag_ev_m).
oe_mag_dispatch_roman = {
    if = {
        limit = { trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mag_ev_m } NOT = { global_var:oe_mag_ev_m = global_var:oe_mag_m } } }
        if = {
            limit = { oe_mag_open_9 = yes OR = { NOT = { tag = BYZ } oe_ml_free = yes } }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_fired_9 value = 1 }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_ev_m value = global_var:oe_mag_m }
            if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mag_sent_cnt } change_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_sent_cnt add = 1 } }
            else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_sent_cnt value = 1 } }
            if = { limit = { tag = BYZ } oe_ml_take_as = { line = 63 } }
            trigger_event_non_silently = oe_mag.9
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { oe_mag_open_10 = yes OR = { NOT = { tag = BYZ } oe_ml_free = yes } }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_fired_10 value = 1 }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_ev_m value = global_var:oe_mag_m }
            if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mag_sent_cnt } change_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_sent_cnt add = 1 } }
            else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_sent_cnt value = 1 } }
            if = { limit = { tag = BYZ } oe_ml_take_as = { line = 63 } }
            trigger_event_non_silently = oe_mag.10
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { oe_mag_open_11 = yes OR = { NOT = { tag = BYZ } oe_ml_free = yes } }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_fired_11 value = 1 }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_ev_m value = global_var:oe_mag_m }
            if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mag_sent_cnt } change_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_sent_cnt add = 1 } }
            else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_sent_cnt value = 1 } }
            if = { limit = { tag = BYZ } oe_ml_take_as = { line = 63 } }
            trigger_event_non_silently = oe_mag.11
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { oe_mag_open_12 = yes OR = { NOT = { tag = BYZ } oe_ml_free = yes } }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_fired_12 value = 1 }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_ev_m value = global_var:oe_mag_m }
            if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mag_sent_cnt } change_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_sent_cnt add = 1 } }
            else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_sent_cnt value = 1 } }
            if = { limit = { tag = BYZ } oe_ml_take_as = { line = 63 } }
            trigger_event_non_silently = oe_mag.12
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { oe_mag_open_8 = yes OR = { NOT = { tag = BYZ } oe_ml_free = yes } }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_fired_8 value = 1 }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_ev_m value = global_var:oe_mag_m }
            if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mag_sent_cnt } change_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_sent_cnt add = 1 } }
            else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_sent_cnt value = 1 } }
            if = { limit = { tag = BYZ } oe_ml_take_as = { line = 63 } }
            trigger_event_non_silently = oe_mag.8
        }
    }
}

oe_mag_dispatch_corsair = {
    if = {

        if = {
            limit = { oe_mag_open_3 = yes  }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_fired_3 value = 1 }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_ev_m value = global_var:oe_mag_m }

            else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_sent_cnt value = 1 } }

# Public monthly entry point (scheduler slot 63 AND oe_mag_pulse.txt fallback).
# Strictly idempotent per calendar month via oe_mag_ran_m.
oe_mag_monthly = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_m value = oe_mag_m_now }
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_mag_done }
            trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mag_ran_m } NOT = { global_var:oe_mag_ran_m = global_var:oe_mag_m } }
        }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_ran_m value = global_var:oe_mag_m }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_mag_init } }
            oe_mag_init_line = yes
        }
        if = {
            limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mag_on }
            if = {
                limit = { current_year > 1685 }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_end value = 3 }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_done value = 2 }
                remove_global_variable = oe_mag_on
            }
            else = {
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1445 trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mag_fired_1 } NOT = { global_var:oe_mag_fired_1 = 1 } } trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mag_fired_1 } NOT = { global_var:oe_mag_fired_1 = 2 } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_fired_1 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1515 trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mag_fired_2 } NOT = { global_var:oe_mag_fired_2 = 1 } } trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mag_fired_2 } NOT = { global_var:oe_mag_fired_2 = 2 } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_fired_2 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1610 trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mag_fired_3 } NOT = { global_var:oe_mag_fired_3 = 1 } } trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mag_fired_3 } NOT = { global_var:oe_mag_fired_3 = 2 } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_fired_3 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1650 trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mag_fired_4 } NOT = { global_var:oe_mag_fired_4 = 1 } } trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mag_fired_4 } NOT = { global_var:oe_mag_fired_4 = 2 } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_fired_4 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1680 trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mag_fired_5 } NOT = { global_var:oe_mag_fired_5 = 1 } } trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mag_fired_5 } NOT = { global_var:oe_mag_fired_5 = 2 } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_fired_5 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1490 trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mag_fired_6 } NOT = { global_var:oe_mag_fired_6 = 1 } } trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mag_fired_6 } NOT = { global_var:oe_mag_fired_6 = 2 } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_fired_6 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1620 trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mag_fired_7 } NOT = { global_var:oe_mag_fired_7 = 1 } } trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mag_fired_7 } NOT = { global_var:oe_mag_fired_7 = 2 } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_fired_7 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1680 trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mag_fired_8 } NOT = { global_var:oe_mag_fired_8 = 1 } } trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mag_fired_8 } NOT = { global_var:oe_mag_fired_8 = 2 } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_fired_8 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1680 trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mag_fired_9 } NOT = { global_var:oe_mag_fired_9 = 1 } } trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mag_fired_9 } NOT = { global_var:oe_mag_fired_9 = 2 } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_fired_9 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1680 trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mag_fired_10 } NOT = { global_var:oe_mag_fired_10 = 1 } } trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mag_fired_10 } NOT = { global_var:oe_mag_fired_10 = 2 } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_fired_10 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1680 trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mag_fired_11 } NOT = { global_var:oe_mag_fired_11 = 1 } } trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mag_fired_11 } NOT = { global_var:oe_mag_fired_11 = 2 } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_fired_11 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { current_year > 1680 trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mag_fired_12 } NOT = { global_var:oe_mag_fired_12 = 1 } } trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mag_fired_12 } NOT = { global_var:oe_mag_fired_12 = 2 } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_fired_12 value = 2 } }
                # Refresh theater hosts cleanly (O(1) tag/hub lookups, all has_owner guarded).
                oe_mag_resolve_roman_host = yes
                if = { limit = { oe_mag_has_live_roman_host = yes } global_var:oe_mag_host_roman = { oe_mag_dispatch_roman = yes } }
                if = {
                    limit = { trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mag_ev_m } NOT = { global_var:oe_mag_ev_m = global_var:oe_mag_m } } }
                    oe_mag_resolve_corsair_host = yes
                    if = { limit = { oe_mag_has_live_corsair_host = yes } global_var:oe_mag_host_corsair = { oe_mag_dispatch_corsair = yes } }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mag_ev_m } NOT = { global_var:oe_mag_ev_m = global_var:oe_mag_m } } }
                    oe_mag_resolve_maghreb_host = yes
                    if = { limit = { oe_mag_has_live_maghreb_host = yes } global_var:oe_mag_host_maghreb = { oe_mag_dispatch_maghreb = yes } }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mag_ev_m } NOT = { global_var:oe_mag_ev_m = global_var:oe_mag_m } } }
                    oe_mag_resolve_wa_host = yes
                    if = { limit = { oe_mag_has_live_wa_host = yes } global_var:oe_mag_host_wa = { oe_mag_dispatch_wa = yes } }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

oe_mag_job_121 = {
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_exarch_step value = 4 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_revival_path value = 1 }
        add_gold = -200
        add_stability = -2
        add_prestige = 15
        oe_mag_relieve_ar_strain = { amount = -5 }
        if = { limit = { OR = { oe_mag_has_prf_africa = yes oe_mag_africa_assim_active = yes } } add_stability = 4 oe_mag_relieve_ar_strain = { amount = -3 } }
        oe_mag_upgrade_carthage_see = yes
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_mag_carthage_christian_revival years = 45 mode = replace }
}

oe_mag_job_122 = {
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_exarch_step value = 4 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_revival_path value = 2 }
        add_gold = -140
        add_stability = 5
        oe_mag_relieve_ar_strain = { amount = -3 }
        if = { limit = { OR = { oe_mag_has_prf_africa = yes oe_mag_africa_assim_active = yes } } add_prestige = 8 oe_mag_relieve_ar_strain = { amount = -2 } }
        oe_mag_upgrade_carthage_see = yes
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_mag_african_synod_tolerance years = 45 mode = replace }
}

oe_mag_test_start = {
    oe_mag_test_clear = yes
    oe_mag_init_line = yes
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_mag_m value = oe_mag_m_now }
}

oe_mag_test_month = {
    remove_global_variable = oe_mag_ran_m
    oe_mag_monthly = yes
}

# Stepper for Byzantine Carthage / Africa Exarchate 4-step deep governance + Rome-Sahara (.9 -> .10 -> .11 -> .12 -> .8).
oe_mag_test_carthage_step = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_mag_on } } oe_mag_test_start = yes }
    location:tunis = { change_location_owner = root }
    location:algiers = { change_location_owner = root }
    location:tripoli = { change_location_owner = root }
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_mag_exarch_step } trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mag_exarch_step } global_var:oe_mag_exarch_step < 1 } } }
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_mag.9
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mag_exarch_step trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mag_exarch_step } global_var:oe_mag_exarch_step = 1 } }
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_mag.10
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mag_exarch_step trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mag_exarch_step } global_var:oe_mag_exarch_step = 2 } }
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_mag.11
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mag_exarch_step trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mag_exarch_step } global_var:oe_mag_exarch_step = 3 } }
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_mag.12
    }
    else = {
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_mag.8
    }
}
